# Corne physical layout

`6column.dtsi` is copied unchanged from
https://github.com/zmkfirmware/zmk/blob/4dd95d7840eb3d5a3f59bb29fbf1ab054715ef85/app/dts/layouts/foostan/corne/6column.dtsi
(ZMK main, the commit the keyboard index is generated from). ZMK is MIT-licensed; its licence is `LICENSE` here. The derive tests read
it in place of the network, and treat the committed Corne definition as the answer to compare against.
